The '''Dantari Village''',<ref name="SWG:DV" /> also known as the '''Dantari Rock Village''',<ref name="SWG:DRV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Badge: "Dantari Rock Village" on Dantooine}}</ref> was a settlement of the [[Kunga]] tribe on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dantari Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
